# SummerVestingWalletFactory
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/contracts/SummerVestingWalletFactory.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ISummerVestingWalletFactory](../interfaces/i-summer-vesting-wallet-factory.md), ProtocolAccessManaged

**Title:**
SummerVestingWalletFactory

Factory contract for creating new SummerVestingWallet instances

Creates and tracks vesting wallets for beneficiaries with both time-based and goal-based vesting


## State Variables
### token
The ERC20 token that will be vested


```solidity
address public immutable token
```


### vestingWallets
Mapping from beneficiary address to their vesting wallet address


```solidity
mapping(address beneficiary => address vestingWallet) public vestingWallets
```


### vestingWalletOwners
Mapping from vesting wallet address to its beneficiary address


```solidity
mapping(address vestingWallet => address beneficiary) public vestingWalletOwners
```


## Functions
### constructor

Initializes the factory with the token to be vested


```solidity
constructor(address _token, address _accessManager) ProtocolAccessManaged(_accessManager);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_token`|`address`|The address of the ERC20 token that will be vested|
|`_accessManager`|`address`|The address of the ProtocolAccessManager contract|


### createVestingWallet

Creates a new vesting wallet for a beneficiary

Only callable by the Foundation


```solidity
function createVestingWallet(
    address beneficiary,
    uint256 timeBasedAmount,
    uint256[] memory goalAmounts,
    SummerVestingWallet.VestingType vestingType
)
    external
    onlyFoundation
    returns (address newVestingWallet);
```
